claim: Blood forgives a fall's impact up to a floor (kFallDamageFloor): stepped in MoveDude's own order, a drop from rest of 67,570 z (3.98 standing bodies) or less does no harm, the next unit costs 4 hit points, and 126,957 (7.49 bodies) is the first to take a hundred. Gravity is not added on the tick whose move already reaches the floor, so the body lands at the speed it had. A 3.1-body shaft is therefore a safe one-way drop that nobody can climb back up.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/actor.cpp:4595-4632 (MoveDude: z += zvel>>8, then gravity unless bottom >= floorZ, :4625) and :4826-4847 (landing: nDamage = mulscale30(vax, vax); nDamage -= kFallDamageFloor); actor.cpp:2691-2698 (actFloorBounceVector returns zvel on a flat floor); actor.h:185-187 (kDudeGravity 58254, kFallDamageFloor 100<<4)
